messages:
infra-josh: Hey team — ran into a hard quota while prepping large checkpoints for the model sweep. Jobs need sustained high IOPS for /mnt/checkpoints and we hit EBS IOPS+snapshot API limits in us-west-2. Opening support case with AWS but pushing here for help to expedite. Case AWS-1234567890.

maria: region + instance types? how big are the volumes?

infra-josh: us-west-2, p4de.24xlarge for training, volumes are gp3 8TB each (we're snapshotting frequently). Expected steady-state 25k-40k IOPS per node during checkpoint write. Snapshot create rate spikes when concurrent jobs finish (20+ snapshots/min).

devops-kate: Ouch. gp3 default IOPS is low unless configured — are these provisioned IOPS gp3 or just gp3 baseline? If baseline, we should either provision IOPS or attach multiple volumes and stripe. Also consider using io2 for critical checkpoints but cost jumps.

samir: Can you paste the quota error from the console and the exact AWS quota metric? AWS usually calls it "EBS General Purpose (gp3) IOPS" or "Snapshot creation rate". We'll need target numbers for the request.

infra-josh: Console error: 
```
Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
Error: RequestLimitExceeded
Message: Rate exceeded for CreateSnapshot
Quota metric: EBS-Snapshot-Create-Rate (us-west-2)
Current: 100/min, required ~1200/min during rollouts
```
Also metric for gp3: current account cap 64k IOPS total across volumes, we need bump to 300k for fleet during model sweep.

devops-kate: OK that's a big ask. Short term: can we queue snapshot creation and shard across time windows? Long term: escalate with account team for quota increase + reservation guidance. I can draft the AWS support message.

maria: Also flagging GCS staging bucket issues — when we upload checkpoints to the cross-region staging bucket (gcs://redwood-staging-models) writes are getting throttled, throttling shows 429s from google with message "Too many writes to a single object prefix". We may need to request increased per-bucket throughput or change naming/layout to more prefixes.

infra-josh: Good catch. We currently write many objects under the same prefix per job. Short term I'll change to multi-prefix scheme: gs://redwood-staging-models/{job_id}/{shard}/... Long term I'll file a GCP quota increase for per-prefix write throughput.

devops-kate: Draft for AWS support (you can copy/paste and attach bill center):
```
Hello AWS Support — Account xxxxxxx, us-west-2.
Request: Increase EBS snapshot creation rate from 100/min to 1200/min.
Increase EBS total gp3 IOPS quota from 64k to 300k for region us-west-2.
Use case: ML training fleet (p4de.24xlarge) performing concurrent model checkpointing and snapshotting for automated rollouts. Checkpoints are 2–8TB; we create snapshots as part of CI/CD and recovery tests. This increase is temporary during a scheduled sweep (2 weeks) but we'd like a higher baseline for future runs.
Cost center: infra-ml-sweeps
Contact: infra-josh@redwood.com
Support Case: AWS-1234567890
```

samir: Add the expected dates and traffic windows to the request (start/end). AWS likes those. Also attach the internal cost approval doc.

infra-josh: Good call. Window: 2026-07-01 -> 2026-07-14, peak hours 00:00–08:00 UTC.

cloud-ops-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-8472 and linked AWS support case AWS-1234567890. Assigned to devops-kate. :ticket:

devops-kate: I'll ping our AWS TAM and the account rep. Also starting a parallel request to GCP: increase per-prefix write throughput for gs://redwood-staging-models and request guidance for best-practice prefix sharding. Draft for GCP support: 
```
Project: redwood-inference-prod
Request: Increase per-prefix write throughput / request higher per-bucket QPS for object creation in region us-west1 (staging used for cross-cloud sync).
Use case: ML checkpoints written concurrently by hundreds of workers, creates high QPS to same object prefixes during checkpoint flush and composition. We will adopt multi-prefix names but request higher limits to avoid data loss during migration windows.
Contact: infra-josh@redwood.com
Support case: GCP-987654321
```

maria: For immediate mitigation, can we: 1) stagger snapshot jobs across an hourly window, 2) use fast local NVMe as a write buffer and perform background uploads to EBS/GCS, 3) increase retry/backoff in the snapshotter?

infra-josh: We're implementing 1 & 3 tonight. NVMe buffering needs infra change for durability — will prototype.

samir: Please add the exact billing code/PO for the TAM escalation so finance can pre-approve. Also estimate incremental cost for gp3-provisioned IOPS vs io2 so we can choose.

infra-josh: Estimated delta for 2-week window: ~$28k if we provision gp3 IOPS to 300k vs ~$72k for equivalent io2. I'll put a cost breakdown in INFRA-8472.

devops-kate: I'll follow up with AWS TAM and cc finance + product. If anyone has objections to the 300k target, speak now. Otherwise I'll submit the support request and attach INFRA-8472 and cost approval.

maria: :+1: do it. also pushing the GCS request in parallel.

infra-josh: Thanks — please tag me when support replies. I’ll update the runbook https://internal.redwood/devops/checkpointing and add the prefix-change checklist.
